technical_and_design_decisions: Target JDK 17+ and Spring Framework 6.0 core capabilities, matching modern Spring ecosystem standards.
Implement Kafka starting offset configuration and partition pre-allocation by extending Spring XD Kafka source modules and partition management strategies.
Extend Spring XD MessageBus implementation to support deterministic partition assignment to container nodes at stream deployment time.
Develop the reactor-stream processor module using Project Reactor, implementing sliding time windows and dynamic field aggregation expressions (e.g., min, avg).
Implement microbatching capability by introducing an interval-based message aggregator/buffering component in the Spring XD stream module pipeline.
Use standard infrastructure-as-code and automation tools to provision and configure the performance testing environment on Rackspace.
assumptions: A single developer will execute all activities end-to-end, including design, coding, testing, documentation, and infrastructure provisioning.
One workday represents 8 hours of productive developer effort.
Spark integration (U5) is scoped to research, architectural investigation, POC development, and design recommendations rather than production-grade integration.
Existing Spring XD codebase and core test suites are available and functional on Java 17+.
Access to Rackspace infrastructure and required hardware credentials is provided.

activities.activity_description: Create detailed technical wiki documentation covering configuration guidelines for new sources, sinks, reactor-stream processor, microbatching options, and Kafka partition/offset parameters.
Implement configurable starting offsets for Kafka sources on stream deployment, ensure offset state persistence across module crashes, and handle stream redeployment offset reset logic.
Design and implement pre-allocation logic for Kafka partitions across Kafka source module instances during stream deployment to prevent dynamic rebalancing.
Enhance Spring XD MessageBus core engine to pre-allocate partitions across container nodes upon stream deployment, avoiding rebalancing during container redeployments/crashes.
Conduct architectural research on Spark Streaming integration, build a proof-of-concept module, and write a technical design proposal for Spring XD integration.
Build the reactor-stream processor module supporting time-windowing (--timeWindow), field selection, dynamic aggregation expressions (min, avg), and integration with external streams.
Implement microbatching support across modules with configurable batch intervals (--batchInterval) for improved throughput performance.
Set up performance test environment on Rackspace, script automated benchmark suites, and establish baseline performance metrics for Kafka sources and Spring XD pipelines.
